current.en: Your kaata book lives on your phone. Add people, record what you gave and what you received — in the shop, on the road, with no signal at all. No sign-up, no setup. Open the app and start writing.

current.en: Open a person and tap the WhatsApp button at the top. Kaata opens WhatsApp with a polite, pre-filled message — their name, your shop, their balance, and a private link where they can see their full kaata without installing anything. No copy-paste, no awkward typing. A friendly nudge, sent in seconds.

current.en: A broken or stolen phone used to take the whole book with it — every name, every amount people owed you. Sign in with Google or Apple and Kaata quietly keeps a backup. On a new phone, sign in and everything returns: every person, every entry, every balance.
